news.headline: Datadog Eyes AI-Powered Predictive Monitoring as Enterprise Cloud Demand Grows
news.summary: Datadog (NASDAQ:DDOG) is investing in artificial intelligence capabilities, proprietary models and enterprise sales as it seeks to expand its observability platform’s role in monitoring increasingly complex cloud and AI workloads, Chief Financial Officer David Obstler said during a company session.

news.headline: AI Agents Create Their Own Monitoring Problem. Datadog and Dynatrace Are Racing to Own It
